objective: Test a distinct UTF8-explicit, on-the-fly all-production coverage channel against both prior Cobertura structural failures, before full-project availability or quality evaluation.
selection: Exactly both structural instrumentation failures from the terminal full16 r2 availability pilot; already exposed fixtures, not a favorable sample or independent quality cohort.
tool_version: JaCoCo0.8.12 runtime and nodeps CLI, pinned JDK11 and Defects4J6d54320e0db5a357f9ab38a8e4d2e5aead7e1c09
execution: Fresh canonical buggy fixture, network-disabled bwrap and clear environment. LC_ALL/LANG C.UTF-8, file.encoding UTF-8. Compile production/tests without agent. Only official single-test phase receives JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS agent, file output only, exact all-production top-level and inner-class includes. Ant and test JVMs during that phase may both be instrumented; do not call this test-JVM-exclusive evidence.
binding: Source tree/bytes before and after; compiled production inventory before and after; all top-level classes represented; JaCoCo classinfo IDs bind execinfo IDs; XML source files, class membership, line bounds and counters bind to exact projected source. Unknown/different executed class IDs and instrumentation errors fail. Missing zero-hit data is never negative relevance evidence.
feasibility_gate: Both cases must terminally reproduce the exact original test selector and exception type, with nonempty source-bound executed lines and no source/classfile drift or unmatched executed IDs. No class skipping, automatic retry or failing-case replacement.

D65.product_frontier: Runtime-evidence feasibility and immutable source binding
D65.runnable_work: Two exposed cases plus binder regressions
D65.operational_residue: Public-page review, publishing, fresh confirmation and live activation deferred; no causal blocker to private feasibility

claim_ceiling: Two known-failure feasibility cases only, not full16 availability, ranking quality, native ContextBench or superiority. Eventual comparators must receive identical runtime evidence and execution-cost accounting.
open_questions: Does on-the-fly instrumentation preserve exact failures on both structural cases?
Will a separately frozen full16 cohort meet availability and source binding?
Can positive runtime evidence support a matched quality improvement rather than merely changing inputs?
JaCoCo probes may miss exception-aborted paths; how will a future ranker avoid treating absent coverage as irrelevance?
